name: Docker hosts
author: Netlens
description: Shows your Docker hosts with their containers: state, health, restarts, image, compose project, the ports each container publishes, and containers that have their own address on your network (macvlan / ipvlan) matched to the devices Netlens found. Read-only: it only lists containers and networks. Docker's API gives full control of a host, so talk to it through a read-only socket proxy (see the README), never through an open Docker port.

config.label: Docker hosts
config.help: The address of the read-only Docker socket proxy on each host, separated by spaces or commas (https:// works too). When the proxy runs on the Docker host itself and is reached as 127.0.0.1, add the host's own network address after an equals sign, for example http://127.0.0.1:2375=192.168.0.189.
